title: Zakira.Retrace configuration
description: Configuration for the retrace CLI and MCP server. Lives at $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/Zakira.Retrace/retrace.json, or the platform equivalent.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference, for editor completion.

version.description: Config format version. Bumped only for breaking layout changes.

sources.description: Per-source settings, keyed by the source ids used in URIs and CLI filters.

dataDirectory.description: Override OpenCode's data directory. null auto-detects. Supports $XDG_CONFIG_HOME, ~, and environment variables.

preferLegacyJsonStore.description: Read the legacy JSON tree under storage/ instead of opencode.db. The database is authoritative and far faster; this exists for installs where it is missing or unreadable.

includeChildSessions.description: Include sub-agent and forked child sessions in listings.

minTurns.description: Hide sessions with fewer than this many turns. Copilot CLI writes a row on every launch, so a busy machine accumulates thousands of empty shells.

useNativeSearchIndex.description: Use the harness's own FTS5 index for --live searches instead of scanning turn text.

editors.description: Which VS Code installations to scan.

includeEmptySessions.description: Include chat sessions that contain no requests.

path.description: Full path to the index database. null means <data directory>/index.db.

autoRefresh.description: Top up a stale index inline before a query. Retrace never runs in the background; this happens inside the command that noticed. The top-up is time-boxed and keyword-only, so a query stays fast no matter how far behind the index is.

autoRefreshMinIntervalMinutes.description: Skip the staleness check when the index was refreshed less recently than this, so a burst of queries does not re-probe every source.

autoRefreshMaxSeconds.description: Hard ceiling on how long an automatic top-up may delay a query. When it expires the query answers from what the index already holds and reports the shortfall. 0 removes the ceiling, which only makes sense in a script that wants a fully current index.

autoRefreshEmbed.description: Compute vectors during an automatic top-up. Off by default: inference is the most expensive step and does not belong in front of an interactive query. New sessions are still keyword-searchable immediately; their vectors arrive with an explicit `retrace index refresh`.

includeToolOutput.description: Index tool names, arguments, and captured output for keyword search. Tool output is never embedded regardless.

mode.description: Hybrid degrades to lexical automatically when no embedding model is installed.

rrfK.description: The k constant in reciprocal rank fusion, score = weight / (k + rank).

recencyBoost.description: How strongly recency lifts a result, as a fraction of its fused score. 0 disables it.

workspaceBoost.description: How strongly a session lifts when its working directory matches the current one. 0 disables it.

semanticSessionShortlist.description: Sessions kept after the session-level vector pass. Chunk vectors are loaded only for these, which is what keeps semantic search off a full scan.

enabled.description: When false, indexing is faster and smaller and search runs keyword-only.

model.description: A known model id, or any id when modelPath and tokenizerPath are both set.

modelKind.description: Pooling and prefix family. null infers it from the model id. Getting this wrong is silent: the model still returns a vector, just a materially worse one.

tokenizerPath.description: vocab.txt for WordPiece models, sentencepiece.bpe.model for XLM-R models.

batchSize.description: Chunks per inference batch. Batching is what makes a first build over a large session store finish in minutes rather than hours.

maxThreads.description: Maximum CPU threads ONNX Runtime may use per inference. 0 means half the logical processors. ONNX otherwise takes every core, which on a large machine makes an index build saturate the system rather than merely occupy it.
